thesis: PGNY is a profitable, accelerating-growth name in a clean uptrend that has held its post-earnings gap through a violent risk-off tape, which is relative strength. Premarket 36.08 is already inside the 35.6-36.3 pullback zone, with a stop under the 34.94 swing low and a 3.1 reward/risk to a measured-move target of 39.5. Fundamentals (revenue YoY 1.4% to 5.3% to 8.9%, low dilution risk, forward P/E 15.2) and sell-side support (Truist PT 42, Zacks Rank #1) back the move.
